plugins.name: respire-qoder
plugins.description: respire gives your AI a memory that lasts: auto per-turn recall of your preferences, projects and past lessons; "记：" stores a fact in one line; an end-of-turn check reminds the agent to save new conclusions. Register on https://rsrs.rs for end-to-end encrypted cloud sync so memories follow you across devices and sessions (recommended; local-only without an account). No model required. Issues & PRs: https://github.com/risense-ai/respire-qoder
